name: Team Charmander: Hyper-Offense & Glass Cannon Synergy
archetype: Fast special sweepers, Fire/Psychic glass cannons, and Grass/Flying tech pivots to conquer Water gyms.
gym_duel_rationale: Misty enforces a strict 2v2 duel. Enter the arena with Bellsprout/Butterfree (Grass/Flying quad-resists Grass, resists Water, and uses Compound Eyes 97.5% Sleep Powder + Vine Whip to dismantle Misty) and Charmeleon/Kadabra (blistering 96 Speed Fire/Psychic glass cannon cleaning up with high SpA Psybeam).

roster.progression_notes: High-velocity glass cannon pairing Charmeleon with Kadabra. Yields 96 Base Speed and 93 Special Attack with dual Fire/Psychic STAB and Disable tempo control.
Fusing Route 24 Bellsprout with Butterfree gives Grass/Flying typing that quad-resists Mega Drain and resists Water Pulse. Compound Eyes ensures 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder.
Combines Mankey's physical power with Sandshrew's Ground coverage and physical defense. Vital Spirit grants immunity to sleep moves.
Evolved from the Route 3 $500 Magikarp at Lv. 20 and spliced with Spearow. Intimidate cripples enemy attackers while Bite deals heavy damage.

flex_bench.why_use: Route 24 Oddish spliced with Poliwag absorbs incoming Water attacks completely while providing secondary powder support.
Mt. Moon Clefairy with Magic Guard ignores entry hazard chip and status passive damage.

active_fusions: Charmeleon/Kadabra (96 Spe Fire/Psychic starter glass cannon with STAB Psybeam)
Bellsprout/Butterfree (Grass/Flying Misty counter with 97.5% Sleep Powder and Vine Whip)
Mankey/Sandshrew (Fighting/Ground sleep-immune breaker with Low Kick and Magnitude)
Gyarados/Fearow (Water/Flying Intimidate physical pivot with Bite and Aerial Ace)
unfuse_recommendations: 1. Purchase Super Splicers at Cerulean Poké Mart ($300 at any Mart).
2. Splice Charmeleon with Route 24 Kadabra for 96 Speed Fire/Psychic STAB.
3. Splice Route 24 Bellsprout with Butterfree for 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder to hard-counter Misty.
4. Evolve Route 3 Magikarp to Gyarados (Lv. 20) and splice with Spearow for early Intimidate aerial utility.
upcoming_fusions: Charmeleon/Dugtrio (Chapter 3 Vermilion City starter splice for 100% Electric immunity against Surge)
